dev.useCase: Run the staging app and apply edits as you save.

run.useCase: Use the alias for dev to launch Android.

build.useCase: Create the signed Android store bundle.

test.useCase: Test one screen with Android compilation.

create.useCase: Create a starter app linked to this framework checkout.

module.useCase: Scaffold a TypeScript spec and platform implementations.

update.useCase: Build a signed bytecode update for the configured host.

symbolicate.useCase: Resolve a release crash with its matching local source maps.

doctor.useCase: Check local build prerequisites in a setup script.

logs.useCase: Inspect platform logs while reproducing a problem.
